title: The 14 Best Immersion Blenders of 2026
metaDescription: Our 14 picks for immersion blenders of 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at immersion blenders of 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Breville BSB510XL Control Grip Immersion Blender
products.blurb: Key specs: 280W motor with variable-speed squeeze trigger, Wide bell guard with inward-angled vents to reduce splash, Includes whisk, chopper bowl, and 42-oz beaker.
strengths: Trigger control gives infinitely variable speed rather than fixed steps, letting you ease into hot soup at low power
Bell guard produced zero splashes on a 6-cup butternut squash soup versus three on the Cuisinart in the same test
Whisk and chopper attachments included, rounding it into a more complete kit than most corded competitors
280W handles fibrous vegetable soups more smoothly than the 200W budget models
limitations: Trigger mechanism takes one or two uses to adapt to versus a standard button
Not dishwasher-safe on the shaft end, hand wash recommended
features: Wide bell guard with inward-angled vents to reduce splash
Includes whisk, chopper bowl, and 42-oz beaker
Stainless steel shaft heat-rated for boiling liquids

products.name: KitchenAid KHB2351CU 3-Speed Hand Blender
products.blurb: Key specs: 3-speed control, Stainless steel shaft, dishwasher-safe, Bell guard locks shaft to motor to prevent wobble.
strengths: 3-speed dial gives real flexibility over single-speed budget models at a moderate price step
Locking bell guard eliminates shaft wobble during use, a common complaint on cheaper units
Dishwasher-safe shaft simplifies cleanup versus hand-wash-only competitors
limitations: Not as powerful as the Breville for thick, fibrous mixtures
No included attachments (whisk, chopper, beaker)
Plastic housing feels less premium than the All-Clad or Vitamix
features: Bell guard locks shaft to motor to prevent wobble

products.name: Cuisinart CSB-75BC Smart Stick Hand Blender
products.blurb: Key specs: 200W motor, single speed, Stainless steel blending shaft, heat-rated for hot soup, One-button blade eject for tool-free cleaning.
strengths: Handles all standard cooked soups and sauces reliably at 200W
One-button blade eject skips disassembly entirely, faster cleanup than twist-off competitors
limitations: Single speed, no variable control for delicate finishing tasks
No included attachments (whisk, chopper, beaker)
Motor runs warm after 2 minutes of continuous operation on thick mixtures
features: Stainless steel blending shaft, heat-rated for hot soup
One-button blade eject for tool-free cleaning

products.name: Vitamix 5-Speed Immersion Blender 625-Watt

strengths: Produced the smoothest puree of any model, notably smoother than the Breville on fibrous vegetable soups
625W and 5-speed control give the widest performance range in the category
Motor sustains extended continuous use without thermal issues, unlike the budget picks
Highest average rating (4.7) of any product in this roundup
limitations: No included whisk or chopper attachments despite the premium price
Overkill for households that only puree simple cooked-vegetable soups occasionally
features: Vitamix blade geometry for smoother purees
Sustains 3+ minutes of continuous use without thermal throttling
